q: What carbon data do EU carmakers ask of an auto parts plant near Skopje?
title: Skopje auto parts plants: buyer carbon data
short: Annual Scope 1 and 2 with factors named, a figure per part, renewable power share and a reduction plan. North Macedonia's grid still leans on lignite, so power is often the biggest share. Bills, gas invoices and production by part number are enough to start.
audience: Auto component plants in the Skopje free zones supplying EU carmakers

ul: Scope 1 and 2 for the plant, with the grid factor and year.
A target with the actions behind it.
Gas or LPG for ovens and heat treatment.
Diesel for forklifts and backup gensets.

p: Rooftop solar and guarantees of origin move market based Scope 2. Keep meter data and certificates for the audit.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel, electricity and freight invoices into a dated, fingerprinted record per site, so each figure you send a buyer traces back to the documents behind it.

sources.label: GHG Protocol Corporate Value Chain (Scope 3) Standard
